shared_elements: repeated small chevron-like or branching signs
motifs arranged in vertical columns/fields over the surface
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic linear marks, and the repeated chevron/branch-like signs of A have a loose formal echo in some of the small stick-like signs scattered around the figure in B. But A is wholly abstract, made of stacked herringbone bands and rectangular grids in vertical columns, whereas B is dominated by a large striding human figure with raised arm and a weapon, accompanied by smaller figures, animals and a circle sign — no shared subject, no shared relationships.
